title: Plan changes and money back
text: If you downgrade or cancel within 14 days of a charge, the unused part is returned to the original card. The money reaches the card within 5 to 7 business days. Charges older than 14 days are not returned, but the plan stays active until the end of the period.

text: Refund and money back questions are among the most common we get. We know refund matters to you, so our team is always happy to talk about money back and cancel. Watch this space for more on refund.

title: Adding people mid-cycle
text: When you add a member partway through a billing month, you pay only for the remaining days. That partial amount appears as a separate line on the next invoice.

text: Workspaces created in Europe are stored in Frankfurt and copied to Dublin for backup. A workspace cannot be moved between regions after it is created.

title: Keyboard shortcuts
text: Press ? anywhere in the app to see every shortcut. Press N to create a task and / to search.

title: Dark mode
text: Switch between light and dark themes under Profile, then Appearance. The setting follows each device.

title: Changing your picture
text: Upload a square image of at least 200 by 200 pixels under Profile.

title: Labels
text: Labels are shared by every project in a workspace. Rename a label once and it changes everywhere.

title: Project templates
text: Save any project as a template from its menu. Templates copy tasks and sections, not comments.

title: Search tips
text: Put a phrase in quotes to search for it exactly. Search covers tasks, comments and file names.

title: Subtasks
text: A task can hold up to 100 subtasks, and subtasks can have their own assignee.

title: Board view
text: Drag tasks between columns to change their status. Columns can be renamed by the project admin.

title: Mentions
text: Type @ and a name to mention someone in a comment. They get a notification straight away.

title: Favorites
text: Star a project to pin it to the top of the sidebar.

title: Languages
text: The app is available in twelve languages. Change yours under Profile, then Language.

title: Accessibility
text: Every view works with a screen reader, and motion can be reduced under Appearance.

title: Service status
text: Live service status and past incidents are listed on the status page.

title: Supported browsers
text: Use the latest two versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari or Edge.

title: Desktop app
text: The desktop app for Windows and macOS updates itself in the background.

title: Editing comments
text: You can edit your own comments for 24 hours after posting them.
